passages.title: A Great Plan B
text: Lastly, we went to the studio.
We put on school uniforms for fun.
I said, “Grandma, you look like a student in that uniform.”
We took very nice pictures together.
She said, “Thank you for everything today.
My plan did not work out perfectly, but I was not upset.
koreanText: 나는 “할머니, 그 교복을 입으시니 학생 같아 보여요.”라고 말했다.
우리는 함께 아주 멋진 사진들을 찍었다.
나의 계획은 완벽하게 풀리지는 않았지만, 나는 속상하지 않았다.
